policy_sources.authority: name/version single source of truth; apm.yml mirrors it (see apm-manifest-drift)
[tool.coverage.run] source directories -- authoritative scope for evals-scripts-coverage-floor's per-file coverage check

[tool.ruff] target-version/line-length and [tool.ruff.lint] select/ignore/per-file-ignores -- the authoritative rule set for python-lint, ported from upstream tvna/claude-md; the ruff version itself is pinned in [dependency-groups] dev and resolved through uv.lock

per-skill capabilityAssumption (read by routine-scope-enforcement) and spec.lifecycle.renamedFrom (read by skill-rename-lifecycle); one entry stands in for the glob since every sidecar shares one schema

[tool.mypy] strict-by-default config plus the named Tier A/B/C per-module override allowlist (each override citing issue #684 or a dedicated follow-up tracking reference) -- authoritative scope/strictness for mypy-type-check

gates.rule: Denies a Bash call matching a package/plugin-install verb; denies gh issue/gh pr write subcommands and gh api writes (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, a field flag, or 'mutation' in gh api graphql); on git push, runs skills/outward-artifact-preflight/scripts/scan_provenance.py against the outgoing commit range and warns (never blocks) if it flags something.
Denies a Write call whose file_path case-insensitively matches an existing GitHub/GitLab issue/PR/MR template location.

Requires a new GitHub issue's body (method=="create" only) to contain an ACM table header or an explicit 'ACM: not-applicable (chore|docs|tracking|defect): <reason>' waiver; the CI twin re-checks on issues opened/edited and labels+comments (non-blocking).
gates.trigger: PreToolUse matcher mcp__github__issue_write (hooks/hooks.json); .github/workflows/acm-issue-gate.yml on issues:[opened, edited]

gates.rule: Denies mcp__github__create_pull_request when the head branch has no resolvable upstream or has local commits not yet pushed to it; fails open on any unresolvable local git state.

Requires a PR touching skills/*/SKILL.md to disclose battle-testing-a-skill / evaluating-skill-quality verdicts or waivers under a '## Skill audit evidence' heading; the CI twin additionally requires disclosure for description changes, security-relevant skills, changed design docs, changed checker scripts, and changed deterministic gates. Gate membership is the union of the .github/scripts/gate_*.py / scan_*.py naming convention, every gates[].script path registered in this file, and this file itself; deletions and renames count, and the disclosure must be 'deterministic-gate-quality: RAN' or an explicit waiver with a reason, never 'NOT-RUN'.
gates.trigger: PreToolUse matcher mcp__github__create_pull_request and mcp__github__update_pull_request (hooks/hooks.json); .github/workflows/skill-audit-gate.yml on pull_request

gates.rule: Denies mcp__github__create_pull_request when the PR title/body cites no issue at all, or when any Closes/Fixes-cited issue lacks both an ACM table and a valid waiver, carries a 'tracking' waiver, or is already closed; fails closed on a missing GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN or an unfetchable issue.
Every .gitignore line added in a PR diff must have its de-negated/de-slashed core text referenced, as a whole token, by some file under tests/.

Flags a paragraph (PR body, or diff-added docs/evals/skills Markdown) combining a capability-limitation cue with a tool-fingerprint cue absent an explicit 'tool-fingerprint-disclosure: WAIVED: <reason>' line.
Any changed skills/**/*.md or docs/**/*.md paragraph asserting a title/identity string is this repo's own/established convention must cite a real #N issue.
A docs/superpowers/specs/*routine*.md doc naming a skill whose metadata/gitapex.yaml declares capabilityAssumption: Broad must also cite a concrete scoping mechanism.
Any skills/ directory name removed in a diff (while at least one is added) must appear as some surviving skill's spec.lifecycle.renamedFrom value.
If a changed SKILL.md increases its own count of Stop-boundary bullets plus named dispatch branches, evals/<skill>/tasks/*.yaml must gain at least that many new fixtures.

A changed split.md's gate-result table Fixture column must be a superset of its own declared selection list; a changed SKILL.md precedence sentence needs a matching fixture-pair row in split.md's Equivalence classes table.
Every newly-added '**Iteration:' entry under a '## Kept-edit log' in evals/*/split.md must contain a Transfer check line.
Every file under each of pyproject.toml's [tool.coverage.run] source directories must meet a minimum per-file coverage percentage, read from coverage.json.
apm.yml's name/version must equal .claude-plugin/plugin.json's (plugin.json is authoritative); raises if either manifest is missing a mirrored field.
gates.trigger: tests/test_scan_apm_manifest_drift.py inside the pytest step of .github/workflows/test.yml

gates.rule: No .github/workflows/*.yml/.yaml may reference a flake-owned Class B tool's (microsoft/waza, microsoft/apm, rtk-ai/rtk, betterleaks/betterleaks) upstream repo in an install context -- they must come from flake.nix only.
gates.trigger: tests/test_scan_toolchain_pin_drift.py inside the pytest step of .github/workflows/test.yml

gates.rule: docs/security-control-inventory.md's ASI section must have exactly one row per ASI01-ASI10, each with a status in {covered, partially covered, not covered, not applicable} and a rationale prefixed by exactly one of [deny]/[require_approval]/[allow].
gates.trigger: tests/test_gate_owasp_asi_mapping.py inside the pytest step of .github/workflows/test.yml

gates.rule: Sibling gate to owasp-asi-mapping-completeness, for the exact-pinned heading '## OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and Generative AI (LLM01-10:2025)', LLM01-LLM10.
gates.trigger: tests/test_gate_owasp_llm_mapping.py inside the pytest step of .github/workflows/test.yml

gates.rule: Lists every retrospective-labelled issue (any state) and fails the job if the count with zero commit on main citing it exceeds threshold 20.
Executes each PR-touched skill's own evals/<skill>/ suite via 'nix run .#waza -- run <skill>' and fails the job if any suite fails; not yet a required status check.
Runs actionlint (rhysd/actionlint, digest-pinned) against changed .github/workflows/** files.

Runs 'uv run --locked ruff check .' over the whole repository; the rule set is pyproject.toml's [tool.ruff.lint] select/ignore/per-file-ignores and the ruff version is the one pinned in uv.lock. --locked (not --frozen) additionally asserts uv.lock is still in sync with pyproject.toml, so bumping the ruff pin without running 'uv lock' fails the job instead of silently enforcing the previously locked version.
gates.trigger: .github/workflows/lint.yml on every pull_request and on push to main; deliberately no paths: filter, so a required check on this job never enters GitHub's Pending-forever state

gates.rule: Runs 'uv run --frozen mypy --config-file pyproject.toml' as 7 directory-grouped invocations over tests/, hooks/, .github/scripts/, evals/scripts/, and every skills/*/scripts/ directory -- a single repo-wide sweep errors 'Duplicate module named' on two same-basename check_acm_present.py files with no shared __init__.py. strict=true by default, with a named per-module override allowlist for pre-existing typing debt (each entry cites issue #684 or a dedicated follow-up). pydantic is deliberately scoped narrower than this gate's own mypy coverage: several .github/scripts/ and evals/scripts/ files are invoked by their own small dedicated CI workflow with no dependency-install step, so they stay pydantic-free even though mypy still type-checks them.
gates.trigger: .github/workflows/test.yml, mypy job, on every pull_request and push to main

gates.rule: On flake.nix/flake.lock changes: fails if flake.lock is stale after nix flake lock, or if nix flake check, the Class-B build, or the devShell smoke step fail.

Validates .gitapex/ssot.json against .gitapex/ssot.schema.json (JSON Schema draft 2020-12); fails if any gates[].script path doesn't exist as a real file, or any policy_refs[] value doesn't resolve to a real policy_sources[].id.
gates.trigger: tests/test_scan_ssot_schema.py inside the pytest step of .github/workflows/test.yml

gates.rule: Every hook command in a hooks.json manifest or an agent definition's frontmatter must reference the plugin root as ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; the unbraced $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT fails. apm substitutes only the braced form, so an unbraced command is deployed verbatim into a consumer's .claude/settings.json, resolves against an unset variable, and its hook silently never fires while the install log still reports it integrated. Only command values are graded, never prose. Discovery reads git-tracked files, so every ignored path (apm's package cache and deploy trees, worktree checkouts) is out of scope by construction. Exits 2, never a silent pass, when no surface is discovered or a file is unreadable or malformed.
gates.trigger: .github/workflows/plugin-root-brace-notation-gate.yml on pull_request, plus tests/test_gate_plugin_root_brace_notation.py inside the pytest step of .github/workflows/test.yml

clusters.outward-hygiene: Provenance and outward-facing-artifact hygiene checks on text bound for a public push/release.
clusters.github-operations: Direct guards on the GitHub write/PR-open surface.
clusters.plan-integrity: Pre-work planning artifacts (Acceptance Criteria Maps) required before an issue is considered ready.
clusters.skill-lifecycle: SKILL.md authoring, rename, audit-disclosure, and fixture-coverage discipline.
clusters.repo-hygiene: Repository-file-level conventions such as .gitignore pattern test coverage.
clusters.self-governance: The repo's own doc-integrity and self-referential-claim checks (OWASP mappings, retro-title/routine-scope citation, retro backlog cap).
clusters.supply-chain: Toolchain and dependency provisioning, and manifest-identity drift.
clusters.test-integrity: Test-suite coverage floors backing the other clusters' own gates.
clusters.registry-integrity: Self-validation of this registry file itself against its schema and against the repo's real files.
